title: LivSafe: Deep Learning-based Liver Fibrosis Grading System with LLM-based Conversational Support
description:
LivSafe is an application for doctors and hospitals aiding in automatic grading of liver fibrosis using patients' liver ultrasound scans. It features a ViT trained via LivSCP, and MedGemma 27B with MedRAG and llama.cpp.
